Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: trader leaving alert
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Warns when an orbital trader has less than 6 hours before leaving.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: undraft after tucking
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Drafted colonists are undrafted after carrying someone to a bed or a cryptosleep casket, so they can go back to work or give medical care.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: show source mod
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Adds a line to the info card saying which mod each thing comes from.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: ding when loaded
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Plays a short bell when the game finishes loading to the main menu.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: FPS and TPS meter
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Shows frames per second and ticks per second in the top-left corner.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: pawn notes
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Adds a Notes tab to people, for your own notes. Notes are saved with the game.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: medical tab
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: A main tab listing colonists, prisoners and animals by health, with bleeding, pain, wounds to treat and the worst condition.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: more camera zoom
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Lets the camera zoom out much further and in a bit closer, which helps with large ships and orbit maps.

MainButtonDef.label: medical
MainButtonDef.description: Health overview of colonists, prisoners and animals.
